title: Applying Psychometrics to Large Language Model Simulated Populations: Recreating the HEXACO Personality Inventory Experiment with Generative Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the consistency of agents' self-ratings on gender-specific antonym adjective pairs (e.g., ladylike-unladylike, manly-unmanly) across male and female personas.
Observing the extent to which agents rely on broadly stereotyped associations to assign personality traits based on the occupation provided in their generated biographies.
